{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with revenue parsed
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check for missing age data
missing_age_count = (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Missing age (marked as -1): {missing_age_count}')

# View distribution of channels and customer segments
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
tab = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print('\nChannel vs Customer Segment cross-tab:')
print(tab)"}
